analysis.accuracy: All held-out cases, teacher-forced token/payload accuracy, free-running token accuracy, exact continuation; decoding agreement separately gated against uncached greedy.
analysis.across_seeds: For each dataset report all three training estimates and their geometric mean; report min/median/max of the three dataset geometric means. These are descriptive ranges, not population confidence intervals. No pooling of raw repeats across datasets.
analysis.correctness: Any token disagreement in audit, warmup or measurement aborts the configuration; never omit a failed configuration or substitute another seed.
analysis.limits: Three synthetic datasets and three paired training seeds, one tiny FP32 CPU model size, shared host. Conditional case bootstrap excludes training/dataset and host uncertainty. No natural-language, large-model, GPU or sampling generalization.
analysis.primary: For each case, median of six paired greedy/method latency ratios; per-configuration estimate is median across timed cases. Values <1 are slowdowns; retain every sample.
analysis.timing: Separate three-method block per draft length; independent contemporaneous greedy baseline. Random base order per case, cyclic rotation over six repetitions; each method occupies each position twice. Length order alternates by configuration index.
analysis.uncertainty: Percentile 95% bootstrap interval resampling whole cases (all six pairs together), conditional on this fitted target and dataset. Fixed PRNG reset per task/method. No timing repetition is an independent dataset or training trial.
